findings.evidence: The declaration search finds only the definition at line 44; no membership theorem exists. Mathlib's LinearMap.mem_ker characterizes ker, but applying it here requires unfolding UniversalOneForms.
findings.fix: Add UniversalOneForms_def and a simp membership theorem stating t ∈ UniversalOneForms k A ↔ LinearMap.mul' k (Unitization k A) t = 0.
findings.issue: UniversalOneForms has no public definition or membership characterization, forcing consumers constructing or inspecting forms to unfold its body.

findings.evidence: Both private proofs use only TensorProduct.inductionOn, the outer-action pure-tensor formulas, distributivity, and mul_assoc; their conclusions concern multiplication on the full tensor product.
findings.fix: Generalize both identities to an arbitrary associative algebra and export them from tensor-product infrastructure, then use them here.
findings.issue: multiplication_leftAction and multiplication_rightAction (line 79) hide general tensor-multiplication equivariance results; neither proof uses the kernel or any property specific to unitization.

summary: The multiplication-kernel definition lacks a public membership characterization, and reusable tensor-multiplication identities are hidden as private helpers.
